problem: testIndividualInkTargetsAtAccessibilityTextSize: native ink rail loses drag after a button begins tracking

stage_B.expected: Fit Width scrolls into view after measured -58pt drag
stage_B.actual: Fit Width remains x431.3333 and native offset remains -62
stage_B.measurement: Iterations of the same original Accessibility case

root_cause.direct_observations: Delayed touch starts tracking the size UIControl before the pan; native scroll then stops tracking without scrolling. Successful control begins panning without observed UIControl tracking.
root_cause.supported_inference: Inherited UIScrollView default cancellation policy refuses to cancel UIControl tracking. The 150ms touch handoff races native pan recognition, making success depend on input/run-loop timing.
root_cause.status: strongly supported; exact default callback invocation not captured on old source
interpretation_limits: Method identity proves inherited implementation, not invocation/returned value in the failed touch
Read-only run-loop sampling can miss brief states and diagnostic logging can perturb timing; do not treat instrumented success as a repair

video_review.observation: Rail stays stationary; no visible menu or modal during the failing input

decision: Capture goal met; no repeat of unchanged diagnostic. Test one owned native cancellation policy candidate.

next_candidate.scope: Only own the ink rail scroll container and allow native cancellation of a tracking UIControl; retain exact HStack/buttons/Menu/picker/actions/style, ordinary touch delivery, models, data format and navigation boundary
proof_required: Actual override callback on tested rail showing inherited=0 cancel=1 controlTracking=1
Original phone Accessibility until first failure/max3 then related Standard and navigation
Only after phone success, original iPad Accessibility/Standard/navigation; wide iPad need not scroll if all targets fit
Actual effective safe-area viewport, height/content width and reachability match approved layout
next_candidate.independent_review: No blocking actual-source compile/layout/lifecycle issue found; native qualification pending
